title: Chesty Deals
intro: Look for Chesty Deals at participating MCCS Facilities and discover savings that deliver value.

sections.markdown:
Tell us how we're doing so we can improve!

sections.heading: VETERANS DAY SPECIALS
sections.markdown:
- **NOV 6-7** [MCX](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/shopping/marine-corps-exchange): Free coffee all day any cup, any size, any Marine Mart or MCX location that has a coffee bar
- **NOV 11** [Alohana Acai](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/restaurants): $2 off 24 oz. bowl or smoothie _all Camp Pendleton locations*_
- **NOV 11** [Dunkin](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/restaurants): Free donut for veterans and active duty all Camp Pendleton locations*
- **NOV 11** [Jersey Mike's](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/restaurants): Buy any regular sub and drink, get another regular sub of equal or lesser value free all Camp Pendleton locations*
- **NOV 11** [Moe's Southwest Grill](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/restaurants): Free side of chips and queso*
- **NOV 11** [Qdoba](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/dining/restaurants): Free side of chips and queso*

_* All offers are available while supplies last. Restrictions, terms, and details may vary by vendor. Please refer to each vendor's specific offer information for full details._
